title: Towards Trustworthy AI: Characterizing User-Reported Risks across LLMs “In the Wild”
reasoning: The paper is an empirical HCI (Human-Computer Interaction) study that characterizes user-reported risks using social media data from Reddit. While it uses the NIST AI RMF framework which includes categories like 'Fairness' and 'Safe' risks, its primary goal is the categorization and statistical analysis of user experiences rather than the specific evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
